# tip.md - Multichain Crypto Tipping Platform

> Tip.md enables developers to receive cryptocurrency tips (Ethereum, Base, Solana, Bitcoin Lightning) via a simple button embeddable in GitHub READMEs, websites, or any markdown content. Features direct-to-wallet payments, client-side fee splitting, Farcaster mini app integration, and MCP server for AI assistants.

Tip.md provides a user-friendly interface for setting up wallets, generating tipping button snippets (markdown/HTML), viewing donation history, and discovering trending developers. It supports multiple blockchains with automated fee distribution and includes a native Farcaster mini app for seamless social tipping within Warpcast.

*This llms.txt file helps LLMs understand the core features and documentation structure of the Tip.md platform.*

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://www.tip.md/getting-started.md): Account setup and initial wallet configuration.
- [Button Setup](https://www.tip.md/button-setup.md): Adding the tip button to markdown/GitHub.
- [Receiving Tips](https://www.tip.md/receiving-tips.md): How donations work, fee structure (4%), viewing history.
- [Wallet Management](https://www.tip.md/wallet-management.md): Details on supported blockchains (ETH, Base, SOL, BTC Lightning) and address management.
- [Farcaster Mini App](https://www.tip.md/farcaster-miniapp.md): Using tip.md within Warpcast, social tipping, developer discovery, and dev stats sharing.
- [MCP Server](https://www.tip.md/mcp-server.md): Connect your AI assistants to tip.md's MCP service for crypto tipping. Features 7 specialized tools including advanced x402 payment protocol with CDP automatic disbursement (built for Coinbase hackathon). Available tools: tip_user_x402, crypto_tipping, check_tipping_balance, withdraw_tipping_funds, export_tipping_wallet, get_user_wallet_types, and ping.
- [FAQ](https://www.tip.md/faq.md): Answers to common questions.
